PART I

Item 1. Business

WidgetCo designs, manufactures, and sells widgets worldwide. Our fiscal year ends on December 31. For a discussion of risks affecting the business, see Item 1A of this report.

We operate two segments: Consumer Widgets and Industrial Widgets.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Competition could reduce widget margins. The widget industry is intensely competitive and characterized by rapid commoditization.

Supply-chain concentration: we source flux capacitors from a single supplier.

Item 2. Properties

Our headquarters are located in Springfield. We own one widget plant and lease three distribution centers.

PART II

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue increased 12% year over year driven by Industrial Widget volume. Gross margin declined 80 basis points due to input costs.
